aiTitle: Fix payment status showing pending after delivery

content.text: Now `paymentText` (which references `isPaid`) will correctly show "Cash — Received" / "UPI — Paid" once the order is delivered. Let me typecheck the build.

Typecheck passes. The fix is done.

## What was wrong

On the farmer order-detail page, the Payment field showed **"Payment Pending"** even for orders that were already **Shipped** and **Delivered**. The cause was in `paymentText` (`src/app/farmer/dashboard/orders/[id]/page.tsx`): it only counted payment as settled when `payment_status === 'completed'`. For self-pickup/COD orders, payment_status is never flipped to `completed` automatically — the cash is handed over at pickup — so it stayed "pending" forever even after the order was collected.

## The fix

A delivered order means the money already changed hands (cash taken at pickup; an online order would never be shipped unpaid). So I now treat any order with `received_at` or `collected_at` set as paid:

```ts
const isDelivered = !!order?.received_at || !!order?.collected_at
const isPaid = order?.payment_status === 'completed' || isDelivered
```

Since `paymentText` already keys off `isPaid`, delivered orders now correctly read **"Cash — Received"** (COD/pickup) or **"UPI — Paid"** (online) instead of "Payment Pending."

Note: this is display-only — it doesn't write `payment_status` to the DB. If you'd rather have "Delivered" also persist `payment_status = 'completed'` at the source (so the orders list, exports, etc. all agree without each screen re-deriving it), say the word and I'll update the deliver/collect handler instead.
You said "deploy" — prod deploys from `main` on push (per Vercel). I'm on `main` with the one fix staged. I'll commit and push.
